The '''V-35 Courier''' was a reliable, inexpensive [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] several decades before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:V35courier_egvv.jpg|thumb|left|180px|V-35 [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]

The SoroSuub V-35 Courier landspeeder was designed as a family vehicle, capable of carrying three humanoids and featured a large cargo space behind the seats. The V-35 housed a large [[Maglift repulsorlift engine|Maglift]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] drive, and three rectangular [[Mk.4 LoFlow cluster turbine|Mk.4 LoFlow cluster]] turbines were mounted atop the speeder.

Additionally, a scanner scope was fitted to the roof of the speeder, just beyond the cockpit and tapering nose. Though practical for family use, the V-35 was no sports vehicle, thanks to a meager top speed of 100 kilometers per hour.

==History==
<div style="float:right">[[File:Lars_landspeeder.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The V-35 belonging to Owen Lars]]</div>
Five years prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used a V-35 landspeeder during a mission on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] used modified V-35s as patrol speeders.

Later, the Lars family purchased a V-35, which they used to travel to and from the nearby settlement of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. Despite the Courier's age, [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] kept the speeder in excellent condition through routine maintenance and occasional upgrades&mdash;though Luke still preferred his faster [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]].
